messages:
mira: Rainy weekend incoming — looking for shortish (<=90m) deep-dive docs to curl up with, and a low-effort kitchen playlist (simmering, slow jazz, lo-fi vibes). Hit me with recs!
ajay: If you want short + dense: 'Tower' (about 50m) — super emotional. For something meditative: 'Kedi' is ~80m and gorgeous. Playlist: my 'Kitchen Rain' on Spotify -> https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2kitchenrain (low-fi, light piano). :droplet::musical_note:
tae: recs: 'Faces Places' is gentle and about art & memory (right at 90m). 'The Barkley Marathons: The Race That Eats Its Young' is quirky and like 70m if you want weird energy. Also add Nils Frahm / Ólafur Arnalds to that playlist. @mira
sophia: If you want something more essay-ish try 'Stories We Tell' (family doc) — feels intimate. For a movie that's basically a long, quiet poem: 'Paterson' (not a doc but perfect if you want background calm). :coffee:
michael: playlist add: tiny acoustic, slow grooves, background ambient. I threw together a 30-track 'kitchen-simmer' list: spotify:playlist:6kitchenSimmer (you can open with `open "spotify:playlist:6kitchenSimmer"` on mac). Also recommend the short doc 'Blackfish' if you want something heavier but compact.
ajay: @mira quick tip — if you want purely ambient, search "Billow" on Spotify, it's basically warm noise. :headphones:
librarian-bot: Added the following to Mira's Watchlist: [Faces Places; Tower; Kedi; Stories We Tell] — link: https://internal.redwood/watchlists/mira-rainy-weekend
tae: poll: watch party Sat 7pm? React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no. I'll queue up Kedi + Paterson if we get >3 👍
mira: Thanks all!! Saving these. If anyone wants to drop extra tiny album recs for stirring soup, please do. ❤️
